title: Settings: an env-pinned field offers no way to clear the value saved beneath the pin
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Filing gate: ③ a maintainer ruling that names this card: #30385 ruling A (Ruling confirmed on the card, maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-05T21:34Z), item 5 — "The ui half (a clear control on a locked field, which needs the server to say whether a stored value sits beneath the pin) is a separate `domain:ui` card." ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p2 (the server half is p1).
Blocked-by: #30823
Dedupe: `clear locked field settings ui`. Nearest: #30385 (server half, PR #30448). **New.**

## What happens

A settings field pinned by an environment variable shows the lock badge and is read-only. When a value was saved before the pin (the #30385 case: an allowed-IP list saved in Setup, then pinned by `OS_AUTH_ALLOWED_IP_RANGES` for recovery), the admin has no way in Setup to clear that saved value, so removing the variable later brings the old value back.

After PR #30448 the server accepts a clear (`null`) of an env-pinned key and sets the stored value to `null`; nothing in force changes while the pin holds.

## Expected

- On a locked field that has a stored value beneath the pin, Setup offers "clear the saved value" (wording per the ruling: clear the stored value, never "delete"), with a line that the environment value stays in force.
- On a locked field with no stored value, no control appears.
- The page needs the server to say whether a stored value sits beneath the pin. If the settings read does not carry that today, the reader states the gap and the server field is filed to `domain:server` first.

Reader: `domain:ui` (Setup settings pages).
